item.title: Bandit Algorithm Cha4 Highlights
item.description: Stochastic Bandit: a collection of distributions \(\nu = (P_a: a\in\mathcal{A})\) where \(\mathcal{A}\) is a set of available actions. The learner and the environment interact sequentially over n rounds. In each round \(t\in\{1,...,n\}\) the learner chooses an action \(A_t\in\mathcal{A}\), which is fed to the environment. The environment then samples a reward \(X_t\in\mathbb{R}\) from the distribution \(P_{A_t}\), and reveals \(X_t\) to the learner. Environment class: a class \(\xi\) gives the observer information about the bandits belonging to it.
